# Mohamed Amine Gharrab (M.A.G)

> Full-stack developer at SIMTIS in Casablanca, open to new opportunities.

Full-stack developer in Casablanca. I build web applications, online stores and AI automations that save teams time and help businesses sell more.

Languages: Arabic, French, English. Based in Casablanca, Morocco.
Contact: contact.maminegh@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/m-amine-gharrab · GitHub: https://github.com/M-A-Gharr

## Areas of expertise

- [Custom web application development](https://www.maminegh.com/expertise/web-application-development/): Full-stack developer in Casablanca: internal tools, CRMs and business platforms in React and Node.js, connected to your data and built around your team. Tools: React, Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, ASP.NET, C#, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Supabase.
- [AI automation and team training](https://www.maminegh.com/expertise/ai-automation/): Workflows that write, sort and qualify for you, custom Claude Skills and generative AI training for teams. Tools: Claude, OpenAI, Perplexity, FASHN AI, Make.
- [E-commerce and SEO: PrestaShop, WordPress and Shopify](https://www.maminegh.com/expertise/ecommerce-seo/): Fast PrestaShop, WordPress and Shopify stores that rank on Google: redesigns, custom modules, platform migrations and multilingual SEO, from Casablanca. Tools: PrestaShop, WordPress, Shopify, PHP, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Surfer SEO, Semrush.

## Case studies

- [Simtis Studio: AI-generated model shots from a single product photo](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/ai-fashion-visuals-studio/): An in-house AI studio that turns a photo of a shawl into model shots, with an approval step, quotas per store and product sheets in three languages.
- [Redesign, multilingual SEO and custom modules for a PrestaShop store](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/prestashop-redesign-multilingual-seo/): A three-language PrestaShop redesign: 20+ custom modules, stock connected to the physical stores, and from page 10 to page 1 of Google.
- [A B2B prospecting platform that finds, qualifies and follows leads with AI](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/b2b-lead-intelligence-platform/): A platform that finds target companies, qualifies them with AI and follows each opportunity to the sale, with a person approving every step.
- [An export showcase website and a CRM to win trade buyers abroad](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/export-showcase-site-b2b-crm/): A showcase site for foreign wholesalers, in English and Arabic, connected to a CRM that finds and follows prospects on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.
- [Migrating a fashion store from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/migration-woocommerce-prestashop-9/): How I moved a fashion store from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9 without losing its customers, its order history or its Google rankings.
- [Bakery SaaS: bringing stock, recipes and sales into one application](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/bakery-management-saas/): A bakery management application combining stock, recipes, orders and point of sale, with dashboards and an interface in English, French and Arabic.
- [VR Showroom: connecting virtual property visits to sales follow-up](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/vr-property-showroom-crm/): A personal real estate project combining interactive plans, 3D models, 360° visits and a CRM with lead scoring, assignment and sales follow-up.
- [Invoice extraction with in-app review and editing](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/configurable-invoice-ocr/): Configurable JPG and PDF invoice extraction at OpenView, with in-app editing, human validation and structured JSON or CSV outputs.
- [Medical practice management: records, appointments and invoicing](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/medical-practice-management-mvp/): A C# application combining OCR-assisted records, role-based permissions, telephone bookings, insurance deductions and emailed invoices.
- [A reusable foundation for banking agencies](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/banking-agency-java-jee/): A 2020 final-year project at Eurafric Maroc: Java/JEE application foundations, authentication, REST APIs, customer onboarding and PDF generation.

## Experience

- 2026 – Present: Full-Stack Developer & Digital Solutions, SIMTIS · Casablanca. In-house developer for a group of retail brands. I built an AI studio that turns product photos into model shots, a B2B lead platform, and an export website connected to its own CRM. I also rebuilt a three-language PrestaShop store (20+ custom modules, from page 10 to page 1 on Google), moved another store from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9, and trained the whole group to work with Claude.
- Personal project: Founder, M.A.G Store (Shopify). My own Shopify store for home comfort products, delivering across Morocco with cash on delivery. I built the store and the brand, from the logo to the positioning.
- Oct – Dec 2024: Full-Stack Developer, SaaS Inventory Platform · Casablanca. An inventory, order and sales platform with dashboards and stock alerts, built with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- Aug – Sep 2024: Web Developer, Responsive Business Website · Casablanca. A multilingual business website, designed mobile-first, with analytics and social media connected.
